newsitem.title: USA: Lands' End sales rise led by specialty businesses.
newsitem.headline: Lands' End sales rise led by specialty businesses.

text.p: Lands' End Inc said Tuesday sales for the first quarter ended May 2 totaled $245 million, up 15.5 percent from a year ago, with the increase led by its specialty businesses.
Lands' End, a direct merchant of casualwear, said its core business, represented by its regular monthly and prospecting catalogs, and its international business, also contributed to the sales rise.
Earlier, it reported earnings for the first quarter of $0.35 a share after a $0.20 gain, up from $0.13 a year ago.

Gross profit for the quarter was $112.7 million, or 46.1 percent of net sales, up from last year's $94.7 million or 44.7 percent of sales. The increase in gross profit margin was due to higher initial markups and to less steep markdowns of liquidated merchandise, it said.
First quarter ending inventory was $158 million, down from $163 million a year ago.
